simple.meaning: נָתַשׁ (nâthash) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to tear away.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 21 times across Deuteronomy, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Psalms, Jeremiah, and 4 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 29:27. Its contexts include family, kingship, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָתַשׁ (H5428).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נָתַשׁ (nâthash) / H5428 is traced through Deuteronomy 29:27, 1 Kings 14:15, 2 Chronicles 7:20, Psalms 9:7 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H5428. nathash נָתַשׁ verb pull or pluck up, root out , especially in Jeremiah and later (Ecclus Imperfect 3feminine singular נטע תנתש Eccl 3:9 ; Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; נְתַשׁ ᵑ7 id. ; Syriac tear off, away ; Arabic is loan-word Frä 137 ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular וְנָתַשׁ consecutive 1Kin 14:15 ; 2 feminine singular נָתַשְׁתְּ Psa 9:7 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix וַיִּתְּשֵׁם Deut 29:27 ; 1 singular אֶתּשׁ Jer 12:14 , אֶתּוֺשׁ 24:6 ; 42:10 ; Infinitive absolute נָתוֺשׁ 12:17 ; construct לִנְתֿוֺשׁ 1:10 ; 18:7 , לִנְתשׁ 31:28 (on תֿ see Ges § 45g ); suffix נָתְשִׁי 12:15 ; Participle active נֹתֵשׁ 45:4 , suffix נֹתְשָׁם 12:14 ; — pull or pluck up , with accusative Asherim Micah 5:13 ( מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ ); especially of nation, הָאֲדָמָה ׳וְנ ׳אֶתיִֿשׂ מֵעַל 1Kin 14:15 , so Deut 29:27 ; Jer 12:14 ; 2Chr 7:20 ; מִתּוֺכָם אֶתּשׁ Jer 12:14 ; without וְגו ׳מֵעַל 12:15 , 17 ; opposed to נָטַע 45:4 ; object omitted 24:6 ; 42:10 (both opposed to נָטַע ); so infinitive absolute וְאַבֵּד נָתוֺשׁ 12:17 ; infinitive construct לִנְתֿוֺשׁ 1:10 = 18:7 ; compare 31:28 (see נתץ Qal 2 a ); once of cities נ ׳עָרִים Psa 9:7 thou hast uprooted cities . Niph`al Imperfect 3masculine singular יִנָּתֵשׁ Jer 31:40 it shall not be rooted up (|| יֵהָרֵס , reference to the city Jerusalem); 3feminine singular תִּנָּתֵשׁ Dan 11:4 of kingdom; 3 masculine plural אַדְמָתָם מֵעַל יִנָָּֽתְשׁוּ Amos 9:15 (of Israel; opposed to נָטַע ). — For יִנָָּֽתְשׁוּ Jer 18:14 read יִנָָּֽשְׁתוּ √ נשׁת q. v. Hoph`al Imperfect 3feminine singular וַתֻּתַּשׁ Ezek 19:12 and she was rooted up (of Israel, under figure of vine).
